name: fitness-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Garmin fitness data: activities, sleep, HRV, VO2 max, body battery, and trends.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol server that gives Claude read-only access to your own Garmin Connect data via Garmin's official Personal API. Everything runs locally on your machine — your key, your database, your data. Bring your own Garmin Personal API Token (Settings > Account > Personal API Token in Garmin Connect web). Multi-provider architecture: Strava, Coros and others can plug in later.

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API Token
garmin_api_key.description: Generate in Garmin Connect web: Settings > Account > Personal API Token. Looks like GCDC_<uuid>.<uuid>.<base64>.<id>. Treated as a password — kept only on your machine.

ca_bundle.title: Custom CA Bundle (optional)
ca_bundle.description: Only needed if your network inspects HTTPS (Zscaler, Netskope, etc.). Point this at a PEM file that contains both your system's standard roots and your corporate inspection root. See the README for the macOS recipe.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. Logs go to stderr.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: List workouts between start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive).

tools.name: get_activity_detail
tools.description: Full detail for one activity: splits, HR zones, elevation profile where available.

tools.name: get_sleep
tools.description: Per-night sleep in [start, end]: hours, deep/REM/light/awake minutes, score.

tools.name: get_daily_summary
tools.description: One row per day combining wellness (steps, resting HR, stress, body battery) and sleep.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Aggregate a daily metric into day/week/month buckets (resting_hr, steps, vo2max, hrv, sleep_score, training_load, ...).
